title: Durability
description: Indicates how long a fact is expected to remain valid. Influences time-based decay behavior in the retrieval scoring algorithm.

documentation.permanent: Unlikely to change over a person's lifetime. Very slow decay or none. Examples: date of birth, native language, education history.
documentation.transient: Changes over months or years. Standard decay rate. Examples: job role, tech stack, hobbies, preferred tools.
documentation.ephemeral: Changes frequently — days or weeks. Aggressive decay or explicit expiration. Examples: current location, active projects, current mood.
